relations.zotero_refs:
Author reported for No. 15776 in [8H6M69W4]: bla ma spu rangs pa.
[BAQ9MH4T]: 215, n. 12 reports an information from Tsering Wangchuk about a commentary in the bTsan tradition ascribed to a certain "chos gshes," which the footnote identifies with instance (ID:5214). It might however rather be instance (ID:5218) in which there is reference to the teaching having been transmitted to "dge slong chos she."

comments:
Topical outline of the Ratnagotravibhāga (ID:3749); lemmata for each delineated section are provided in interlinear notes in (ID:5218).

At the end of the text, one finds a history of the transmission of the teachings of the Ratnagotravibhāga (ID:3749) along with the Dharmadharmatāvibhaṅga (ID:5634) which is nearly identical to the one in sKyo ston (ID:4052)'s Theg chen rgyud bla ma'i gdams pa (ID:4838).
The lineage itself diverges after Bla ma do pa (ID:5613).

Author according to [8H6M69W4], No. 15776: bla ma spu rangs pa. This figure is mentioned in the succession of masters in the "lo rgyus" section of the text, but the lineage ends with dge slong chos she.
